milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because the task is to find/locate rails. Rails are at (0,0,5) through (0,0,14) in the final scene. Target is (0,0,7). With max_distance=4, the player must walk at least 3 blocks forward from spawn (0,0,0) to be within range, and must face the rails within 60 degrees. The player's default facing is +Z which aligns with the target, so forward movement is the key requirement.

Uses position_near_with_facing because the task is to find/locate red stained glass blocks in the workshop window. Glass is at (-12,1,-3), (-11,1,-3), (-10,1,-3) on the workshop's south wall. Target is (-11,1,-3). With max_distance=5, player must navigate ~7+ blocks from spawn to reach within 5 blocks of the workshop front wall and face it.

Uses count_in_box_at_most (kind=block) because glass panes drop nothing without Silk Touch — we cannot check inventory. Instead we verify at least 1 of the 3 panes has been destroyed by checking at most 2 remain. Panes are at (-12,2,-3), (-11,2,-3), (-10,2,-3). Box generously encompasses the window area.

Uses position_near_with_facing because the task is to find/locate magenta carpet in the mine chamber. Carpet is at (-5,0,17) through (-5,0,19). Target is (-5,0,18). With max_distance=5, player must navigate deep into the mine tunnel (~13+ blocks from spawn) to reach within range and face the carpet.

Uses inventory_has because crafting oak_planks from oak_logs results in planks appearing in inventory. Player starts with no oak_planks. Supply chest has 8 oak_logs. min_count=1 is used to be robust against the player using some planks for the table before this milestone is recorded in the sequential check.

Uses inventory_has because crafting magenta_wool (shapeless recipe: 1 white_wool + 1 magenta_dye) results in the item appearing in inventory. Player starts with no magenta_wool. Supply chest provides 3 white_wool and 3 magenta_dye.

Uses count_in_box_at_least (kind=block) because building a table means placing oak_planks on top of pre-existing fence posts. Four fence posts are at (5,0,-2), (5,0,-4), (7,0,-2), (7,0,-4) in an open grass area with NO pre-existing oak_planks blocks (workshop uses cobblestone walls, floor is stone). Table surface should be at y=1. Box covers the fence-top area. Any oak_planks detected here must have been player-placed.

Uses position_near_with_facing because the task is to find/locate gold ore in the mine chamber. Gold ore is at (4,0,18), (5,0,19), (4,1,19), (5,1,18) on the right side. Target is (4,0,18). With max_distance=5, player must navigate deep into the mine (~14+ blocks from spawn) to reach within range and face the ore.

Uses count_in_box_at_most (kind=block) to verify at least 1 andesite_stairs block has been broken. Stairs fill (3,0,15) to (5,1,16) = 3 x-positions × 2 y-positions × 2 z-positions = 12 blocks total. Generous box encompasses the entire stair area. max_count=11 means at least 1 must have been mined. Player has iron_pickaxe so the block will break and drop.

Uses inventory_has as the best available proxy because no direct 'eat' detection rule type exists. The pumpkin_pie is in a chest at (-4,0,18) deep in the mine chamber, adjacent to the magenta carpet. The navigational challenge of finding and looting the chest is the substantive part of this task, which inventory_has verifies. Eating the pie once in hand is trivial (right-click). This is an accepted limitation acknowledged by all agents.
